001package dayplanner;
002
003
004/**
005 * <p>
006 * Represents an instant in time with minute-level precision. This is not a
007 * time-zone-aware instant and has no seconds or daylight-saving rules.
008 * </p>
009 * <p>
010 * Each component is stored as a plain integer and validated against the
011 * following ranges:
012 * </p>
013 * <ul>
014 * <li><b>year</b>: 1–9999</li>
015 * <li><b>month</b>: 1–12</li>
016 * <li><b>day</b>: 1 to the maximum days in the given month (respects leap years
017 * for February; see {@link #maxDaysInMonth(int year, int month)})</li>
018 * <li><b>hour</b>: 0–23</li>
019 * <li><b>minute</b>: 0–59</li>
020 * </ul>
021 * <p>
022 * The string form produced by {@link #toString()} is
023 * <code>YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM</code>, e.g. <code>2026/09/15 14:30</code>.
024 * </p>
025 * <p>
026 * There are also static methods for dealing with Time instances.
027 * </p>
028 */
029public class Time implements Comparable<Object> {
030    /*
031     * Static Constants
032     */
033
034    /** Minimum allowable year (1). */
035    private static final int MIN_YEAR = 1;
036    /** Minimum allowable month (1, January). */
037    private static final int MIN_MONTH = 1;
038    /** Minimum allowable day (1). */
039    private static final int MIN_DAY = 1;
040    /** Minimum allowable hour (0). */
041    private static final int MIN_HOUR = 0;
042    /** Minimum allowable minute (0). */
043    private static final int MIN_MINUTE = 0;
044
045    /** Maximum allowable year (9999). */
046    private static final int MAX_YEAR = 9999;
047    /** Maximum allowable month (12, December). */
048    private static final int MAX_MONTH = 12;
049    // There is no MAX_DAY because the highest possible
050    // day is variable, depending on the month.
051    /** Maximum allowable hour (23). */
052    private static final int MAX_HOUR = 23;
053    /** Maximum allowable minute (59). */
054    private static final int MAX_MINUTE = 59;
055
056
057
058    /*
059     * Instance Variables
060     */
061
062    /** The year component (1–9999). */
063    private int year;
064    /** The month component (1–12). */
065    private int month;
066    /** The day component (1 to max days in month). */
067    private int day;
068    /** The hour component (0–23). */
069    private int hour;
070    /** The minute component (0–59). */
071    private int minute;
072
073
074
075    /*
076     * Static Methods
077     */
078    
079    /**
080     * Determines whether the specified year is a leap year.
081     * Code adapted from <a href=
082     * "https://www.programiz.com/cpp-programming/examples/leap-year">Programiz</a>.
083     * 
084     * @param year The year to check.
085     * @return <code>true</code> if the year is a leap year, <code>false</code>
086     *         otherwise.
087     */
088    public static boolean isLeapYear(int year) {
089        if (year % 400 == 0)
090            return true;
091        else if (year % 100 == 0)
092            return false;
093        else if (year % 4 == 0)
094            return true;
095
096        return false;
097    }
098
099    /**
100     * Calculates the maximum number of days in the given month and year.
101     * 
102     * @param year  The year.
103     * @param month The month (1-12).
104     * @return The maximum number of days in that month, or -1 if the month is
105     *         invalid.
106     */
107    public static int maxDaysInMonth(int year, int month) {
108        if (month < MIN_MONTH || month > MAX_MONTH)
109            return -1;
110
111        if (month == 2)
112            return isLeapYear(year) ? 29 : 28;
113
114        return switch (month) {
115            case 1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12 -> 31;
116            default -> 30;
117        };
118    }
119
120    /**
121     * Returns an informative error message if any time component is invalid, or
122     * <code>null</code> if valid.
123     * 
124     * @param year   The year.
125     * @param month  The month.
126     * @param day    The day.
127     * @param hour   The hour.
128     * @param minute The minute.
129     * @return Description of the error, or <code>null</code> if all values are
130     *         valid.
131     */
132    public static String getValidationError(int year, int month, int day, int hour, int minute) {
133        if (year < MIN_YEAR || year > MAX_YEAR)
134            return "Year (" + year + ") must be a positive integer between " + MIN_YEAR + " and " + MAX_YEAR + ".";
135        if (month < MIN_MONTH || month > MAX_MONTH)
136            return "Month (" + month + ") must be between " + MIN_MONTH + " and " + MAX_MONTH + ".";
137        int maxDays = maxDaysInMonth(year, month);
138        if (day < MIN_DAY || day > maxDays)
139            return "Day (" + day + ") is invalid: month " + month + " has max " + maxDays + " days.";
140        if (hour < MIN_HOUR || hour > MAX_HOUR)
141            return "Hour (" + hour + ") must be between " + MIN_HOUR + " and " + MAX_HOUR + ".";
142        if (minute < MIN_MINUTE || minute > MAX_MINUTE)
143            return "Minute (" + minute + ") must be between " + MIN_MINUTE + " and " + MAX_MINUTE + ".";
144        return null;
145    }
146
147    /**
148     * Validates whether the specified date and time values represent a valid time.
149     * 
150     * @param year   The year (must be positive, starting from 1).
151     * @param month  The month (1-12).
152     * @param day    The day (1 to max days in month).
153     * @param hour   The hour (0-23).
154     * @param minute The minute (0-59).
155     * @return <code>true</code> if all values are valid, <code>false</code>
156     *         otherwise.
157     */
158    public static boolean isValidTime(int year, int month, int day, int hour, int minute) {
159        return getValidationError(year, month, day, hour, minute) == null;
160    }
161
162
163
164    /*
165     * Constructors
166     */
167
168    /**
169     * Constructs a <code>Time</code> initialized to minimum allowed values
170     * (0001/01/01 00:00).
171     */
172    public Time() {
173        // Assume default values
174        this.year = MIN_YEAR;
175        this.month = MIN_MONTH;
176        this.day = MIN_DAY;
177        this.hour = MIN_HOUR;
178        this.minute = MIN_MINUTE;
179    }
180
181    /**
182     * <p>
183     * Constructs a <code>Time</code> with specified components.
184     * </p>
185     * 
186     * @param year   The year (1-9999).
187     * @param month  The month (1-12).
188     * @param day    The day (1 to max days in month).
189     * @param hour   The hour (0-23).
190     * @param minute The minute (0-59).
191     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If any component is outside its valid range.
192     */
193    public Time(int year, int month, int day, int hour, int minute)
194    throws IllegalArgumentException {
195        this();
196        setYear(year);
197        setMonth(month);
198        setDay(day);
199        setHour(hour);
200        setMinute(minute);
201    }
202
203    /**
204     * <p>
205     * Copy constructor. Constructs a new <code>Time</code> that is a duplicate
206     * of the given <code>Time</code>, preventing co-references that could cause
207     * privacy leaks.
208     * </p>
209     *
210     * @param other The <code>Time</code> to copy.
211     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code other} is {@code null}.
212     */
213    public Time(Time other)
214    throws IllegalArgumentException {
215        if (other == null)
216            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot copy a null Time.");
217        this.year   = other.year;
218        this.month  = other.month;
219        this.day    = other.day;
220        this.hour   = other.hour;
221        this.minute = other.minute;
222    }
223
224    /**
225     * Constructs a <code>Time</code> by parsing a string in YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM
226     * format.
227     * 
228     * @param formatString String containing at least five numeric components, such
229     *                     as {@code 2026/09/15 14:30}; separators may be slash,
230     *                     colon, comma, or whitespace.
231     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the string is null, empty, has fewer than
232     *                                  5 components, or contains invalid values.
233     */
234    public Time(String formatString)
235    throws IllegalArgumentException {
236        if (formatString == null || formatString.trim().isEmpty())
237            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Time string cannot be null or empty.");
238
239        // Split up components by slashes, colons, commas, or whitespace
240        String[] components = formatString.trim().split("[/:,\\s]+");
241
242        if (components.length < 5)
243            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid time format: expected at least 5 components in '" + formatString + "'.");
244
245        try {
246            int y = Integer.parseInt(components[0]);
247            int m = Integer.parseInt(components[1]);
248            int d = Integer.parseInt(components[2]);
249            int h = Integer.parseInt(components[3]);
250            int min = Integer.parseInt(components[4]);
251
252            String error = getValidationError(y, m, d, h, min);
253            if (error != null)
254                throw new IllegalArgumentException(error);
255
256            this.year = y;
257            this.month = m;
258            this.day = d;
259            this.hour = h;
260            this.minute = min;
261        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
262            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Time components must be integers in '" + formatString + "'.", e);
263        }
264    }
265
266
267
268    /*
269     * Mutators
270     */
271
272    /**
273     * Sets the year if within the valid range (1-9999).
274     * 
275     * @param year The new year.
276     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If year is not between 1 and 9999, or if
277     *                                  the current day becomes invalid for the new year.
278     */
279    public void setYear(int year)
280    throws IllegalArgumentException {
281        if (year < MIN_YEAR || year > MAX_YEAR)
282            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Year (" + year + ") must be a positive integer between " + MIN_YEAR + " and " + MAX_YEAR + ".");
283        int maxDays = maxDaysInMonth(year, getMonth());
284        if (getDay() > maxDays)
285            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Day (" + getDay() + ") is invalid for month " + getMonth() + " in year " + year + ".");
286        this.year = year;
287    }
288
289    /**
290     * Sets the month if within the valid range (1-12).
291     * 
292     * @param month The new month.
293     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If month is not between 1 and 12, or if
294     *                                  the current day becomes invalid for the new month.
295     */
296    public void setMonth(int month)
297    throws IllegalArgumentException {
298        if (month < MIN_MONTH || month > MAX_MONTH)
299            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Month (" + month + ") must be between " + MIN_MONTH + " and " + MAX_MONTH + ".");
300        int maxDays = maxDaysInMonth(getYear(), month);
301        if (getDay() > maxDays)
302            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Day (" + getDay() + ") is invalid for month " + month + " in year " + getYear() + ".");
303        this.month = month;
304    }
305
306    /**
307     * Sets the day if within the valid range for the current month and year. Set
308     * year and month first when changing to a date with a different month length.
309     * 
310     * @param day The new day.
311     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If day is not between 1 and the maximum
312     *                                  days for the current month and year.
313     */
314    public void setDay(int day)
315    throws IllegalArgumentException {
316        int maxDays = maxDaysInMonth(getYear(), getMonth());
317        if (day < MIN_DAY || day > maxDays)
318            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Day (" + day + ") is invalid: month " + getMonth() + " has max " + maxDays + " days.");
319        this.day = day;
320    }
321
322    /**
323     * Sets the hour if within the valid range (0-23).
324     * 
325     * @param hour The new hour.
326     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If hour is not between 0 and 23.
327     */
328    public void setHour(int hour)
329    throws IllegalArgumentException {
330        if (hour < MIN_HOUR || hour > MAX_HOUR)
331            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Hour (" + hour + ") must be between " + MIN_HOUR + " and " + MAX_HOUR + ".");
332        this.hour = hour;
333    }
334
335    /**
336     * Sets the minute if within the valid range (0-59).
337     * 
338     * @param minute The new minute.
339     * @throws IllegalArgumentException If minute is not between 0 and 59.
340     */
341    public void setMinute(int minute)
342    throws IllegalArgumentException {
343        if (minute < MIN_MINUTE || minute > MAX_MINUTE)
344            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Minute (" + minute + ") must be between " + MIN_MINUTE + " and " + MAX_MINUTE + ".");
345        this.minute = minute;
346    }
347
348

350    /*
351     * Accessors
352     */
353
354    /**
355     * Gets the year.
356     * 
357     * @return The year.
358     */
359    public int getYear() {
360        return this.year;
361    }
362
363    /**
364     * Gets the month.
365     * 
366     * @return The month (1-12).
367     */
368    public int getMonth() {
369        return this.month;
370    }
371
372    /**
373     * Gets the day.
374     * 
375     * @return The day of the month.
376     */
377    public int getDay() {
378        return this.day;
379    }
380
381    /**
382     * Gets the hour.
383     * 
384     * @return The hour (0-23).
385     */
386    public int getHour() {
387        return this.hour;
388    }
389
390    /**
391     * Gets the minute.
392     * 
393     * @return The minute (0-59).
394     */
395    public int getMinute() {
396        return this.minute;
397    }

401    /*
402     * Object Overrides
403     */
404
405    /**
406     * <p>
407     * Returns a string representation of this time in <code>YYYY/MM/DD HH:MM</code>
408     * format.
409     * </p>
410     * <p>
411     * Month, day, hour, and minute are zero-padded to two digits; year is
412     * zero-padded to four. For example, September 5, 2026 at 8:03 AM is formatted
413     * as <code>2026/09/05 08:03</code>.
414     * </p>
415     * 
416     * @return Formatted time string.
417     */
418    @Override
419    public String toString() {
420        return String.format("%04d/%02d/%02d %02d:%02d",
421            getYear(), getMonth(), getDay(),
422            getHour(), getMinute());
423    }
424
425    /**
426     * <p>
427     * Compares this time with another object chronologically.
428     * </p>
429     * <p>
430     * Fields are compared in order: year, then month, then day, then hour, then
431     * minute. The first field that differs determines the result.
432     * </p>
433     * 
434     * @param other The other object to compare with.
435     * @return A negative integer, zero, or a positive integer as this time
436     *         precedes, equals, or follows {@code other}.
437     * @throws NullPointerException If {@code other} is {@code null}.
438     * @throws ClassCastException   If {@code other} is not an instance of
439     *                              {@link Time}.
440     */
441    @Override
442    public int compareTo(Object other)
443    throws NullPointerException, ClassCastException {
444        if (other == null)
445            throw new NullPointerException("Cannot compare Time to null");
446        if (!(other instanceof Time))
447            throw new ClassCastException("Cannot compare Time to an object of class " + other.getClass().getName());
448
449        Time o = (Time) other;
450
451        if (getYear() != o.getYear())
452            return getYear() - o.getYear();
453        
454        if (getMonth() != o.getMonth())
455            return getMonth() - o.getMonth();
456        
457        if (getDay() != o.getDay())
458            return getDay() - o.getDay();
459        
460        if (getHour() != o.getHour())
461            return getHour() - o.getHour();
462
463        return getMinute() - o.getMinute();
464    }
465
466    /**
467     * Compares this time with another time chronologically.
468     * 
469     * @param other The other time to compare with.
470     * @return A negative integer, zero, or a positive integer as this time
471     *         precedes, equals, or follows {@code other}.
472     * @throws NullPointerException If {@code other} is {@code null}.
473     */
474    public int compareTo(Time other)
475    throws NullPointerException {
476        return compareTo((Object) other);
477    }
478
479    /**
480     * Determines whether a time period from {@code start} to {@code end} is valid.
481     * Uses {@link #compareTo(Object)} to verify that {@code start} is strictly
482     * before {@code end}.
483     * 
484     * @param start The start time.
485     * @param end   The end time.
486     * @return {@code true} if both times are non-null and {@code start} is strictly
487     *         before {@code end}; {@code false} otherwise.
488     */
489    public static boolean isValidPeriod(Time start, Time end) {
490        if (start == null || end == null)
491            return false;
492        try {
493            return start.compareTo(end) < 0;
494        } catch (ClassCastException | NullPointerException e) {
495            return false;
496        }
497    }
498
499    /**
500     * Determines whether this time is equal to another object.
501     * 
502     * @param other The object to compare with.
503     * @return <code>true</code> if the objects are equal, <code>false</code>
504     *         otherwise.
505     */
506    @Override
507    public boolean equals(Object other) {
508        if (this == other)
509            return true;
510        if (other == null || getClass() != other.getClass())
511            return false;
512        return compareTo((Time) other) == 0;
513    }
514}
